table inet netavark {
	chain INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		ip saddr 10.89.2.0/24 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 accept
		ip saddr 10.234.0.0/24 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 accept
		ip saddr 10.234.1.0/24 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 accept
	}

	chain FORWARD {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		ct state invalid drop
		jump NETAVARK-ISOLATION-1
		ip daddr 10.89.2.0/24 ct state established,related accept
		ip saddr 10.89.2.0/24 accept
		ip daddr 10.234.0.0/24 ct state established,related accept
		ip saddr 10.234.0.0/24 accept
		ip daddr 10.234.1.0/24 ct state established,related accept
		ip saddr 10.234.1.0/24 accept
	}

	chain POSTROUTING {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		meta mark & 0x00002000 == 0x00002000 masquerade
		ip saddr 10.89.2.0/24 jump nv_ff1513d2_10_89_2_0_nm24
		ip saddr 10.234.0.0/24 jump nv_872ecb86_10_234_0_0_nm24
		ip saddr 10.234.1.0/24 jump nv_655c363a_10_234_1_0_nm24
	}

	chain PREROUTING {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		fib daddr type local jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-DNAT
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type nat hook output priority dstnat; policy accept;
		fib daddr type local jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-DNAT
	}

	chain NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-DNAT {
		ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 jump nv_872ecb86_10_234_0_0_nm24_dnat
		tcp dport 8000 jump nv_ff1513d2_10_89_2_0_nm24_dnat
		ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 jump nv_655c363a_10_234_1_0_nm24_dnat
	}

	chain NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK {
		meta mark set meta mark | 0x00002000
	}

	chain NETAVARK-ISOLATION-1 {
		iifname "podman3" oifname != "podman3" jump NETAVARK-ISOLATION-2
		iifname "podman6" oifname != "podman6" jump NETAVARK-ISOLATION-2
		iifname "podman1" oifname != "podman1" jump NETAVARK-ISOLATION-2
	}

	chain NETAVARK-ISOLATION-2 {
		oifname "podman3" drop
		oifname "podman6" drop
		oifname "podman1" drop
	}

	chain NETAVARK-ISOLATION-3 {
		jump NETAVARK-ISOLATION-2
	}

	chain nv_ff1513d2_10_89_2_0_nm24 {
		ip daddr 10.89.2.0/24 accept
		ip daddr != 224.0.0.0/4 masquerade
	}

	chain nv_ff1513d2_10_89_2_0_nm24_dnat {
		ip saddr 10.89.2.0/24 tcp dport 8000 jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK
		ip saddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 8000 jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK
		tcp dport 8000 dnat ip to 10.89.2.4:8000
	}

	chain nv_872ecb86_10_234_0_0_nm24 {
		ip daddr 10.234.0.0/24 accept
		ip daddr != 224.0.0.0/4 masquerade
	}

	chain nv_872ecb86_10_234_0_0_nm24_dnat {
		ip saddr 10.234.0.0/24 ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK
		ip saddr 127.0.0.1 ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK
		ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 dnat ip to 10.234.0.2:3000
	}

	chain nv_655c363a_10_234_1_0_nm24 {
		ip daddr 10.234.1.0/24 accept
		ip daddr != 224.0.0.0/4 masquerade
	}

	chain nv_655c363a_10_234_1_0_nm24_dnat {
		ip saddr 10.234.1.0/24 ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK
		ip saddr 127.0.0.1 ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 jump NETAVARK-HOSTPORT-SETMARK
		ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 47105 dnat ip to 10.234.1.2:3000
	}
}
